subject: Go/no-go gate: launch exceptions and on-call liaison plan
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch gate: exception list & liaison plan (first checkpoint)

Team —

Quick sync to capture the open exceptions that could affect the Thursday launch. This is an ask to each owner to confirm whether the item is a hard blocker for the public rollout or whether we can address it during a limited canary. Please reply inline with one of: BLOCKER / CANARY_OK / WAIVE (with rationale).

Current exceptions from Prod/QA:
- Docs: missing quickstart for private deployment (owner: Marissa) — impacts first-wave customers who self-serve.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown shows a gap for embeddings route under large payloads (owner: Karthik).
- Runtime: degraded tail latency on 8k seq for model-v2-quant (owner: Karthik).
- Legal: redlines pending for SAML addendum (owner: Laura).

Immediate asks:
- Marissa: confirm docs quickstart availability and planned publish date.
- Karthik: estimate mitigation plan for latency and whether we need an SLO exception for 72 hours post-launch.
- Laura: status on SAML redline and whether legal will allow a narrow-country exclusion.
- Ben: coordinate on-call liaison and doc handoff for CS training.

Attachments: design-doc-v2.pdf (design notes), rollout-matrix-compact.xlsx (current matrix).

I want all replies by EOD. If we end up with any BLOCKER flagged, we will set a short meeting tomorrow at 08:30 to decide.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch gate: exception list & liaison plan (first checkpoint)

Jonas —

Answers inline and owners assigned.

- Docs quickstart: CANARY_OK. A pared-down quickstart (private-deploy-quickstart.md) is ready and I can publish to the docs site tonight by 22:00 PT. I'll add a short FAQ about KMS/HSM and networking caveats. Owner for full quickstart follow-up: Marissa (publishing) / Ben (CS runbook).

- Training slots: I need two 60-min enablement sessions for CS + SEs tomorrow AM (08:45 and 10:30). Ben, can you confirm availability and attendee lists?

- Public-facing changelog: WAIVE for now — we will add a short note during the canary window.

I've attached a slim rollout matrix and a one-page TL;DR that can be shared with customer liaisons.

Attachments referenced: rollout-matrix-compact.xlsx, canary-checklist.md

--
Marissa Cole
Director, Developer Experience
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 14:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch gate: exception list & liaison plan (first checkpoint)

Short on infra detail — TL;DR: not a hard blocker, but requires mitigation and a short SLO carve-out.

- Latency on 8k seq (model-v2-quant): BLOCKER for full immediate rollout. The quantized kernel shows a 2.8x tail increase under sustained 16k token windows in our stress runs. Root cause likely a mis-selected attention kernel under the sequence length switch. We can ship to a limited canary that caps requests at 4k tokens while we patch the kernel selection (ETA 48 hrs).

- Cost breakdown for embeddings: CANARY_OK. We will surface a warning in the console and the token-level breakdown will be fixed in the next infra deploy (ETA 24 hrs).

Ask: We need approval for a temporary SLO exception (increase p99 latency allowance for model-v2-quant by 200ms) for 72 hours after release while we perform the kernel rollback/patch. If leadership approves, we'll also add extra tracing on the affected routes.

I'll attach the raw perf logs to the ticket SUP-777; see the JIRA link.

-Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 18:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch gate: exception list & liaison plan (first checkpoint)

Team —

Thanks for the quick updates. A few directives from leadership:

1) If any item is marked BLOCKER (as Karthik has), we are not proceeding with full public launch Thursday. We will allow a narrow canary only if engineering and product commit to a clear rollback and customer notification plan.

2) Approve a temporary SLO exception for a 72-hr canary window for p99 latency increase + additional tracing. Karthik, ensure the exception is documented against SUP-777 and that PagerDuty routing is set to include the infra on-call plus a product liaison.

3) Legal: Laura (me) will sign off on a narrow-region exclusion (EU customers excluded) for the first 48 hours if needed. Marissa, prepare the customer-facing note and CS script for any affected accounts.

Please have a final decision and labeled canary cohort by 08:00 tomorrow. If we still have unresolved BLOCKERS at that time, schedule the 08:30 gate meeting — I will join.

Laura Bennett
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmecloud.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch gate: exception list & liaison plan (first checkpoint)

All — quick confirm from Ops/CS side.

- On-call liaison: Ben Carter (primary) / Ops on-call (secondary). I'll own the customer comms for Acme Cloud during the canary.
- Training: I confirmed the 08:45 slot; CS + 2 SEs from Acme are on the attendee list.
- Canary cohort: 5% of active production customers, regionally restricted to US only; exclude EU per Laura's note.
- Rollback plan: immediate model switch to model-v2-nonquant via feature flag; infra to run rollback verification script (attached: canary-checklist.md).

I have uploaded the canary checklist and a short customer script to the drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-rollout-matrix

Given these mitigations, I mark this THREAD as CANARY_OK per Marissa and Karthik's mitigations.

Ben Carter
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
